name: Stocktwits
description:
Stocktwits connects AI assistants to one of the world’s largest communities of traders and investors.

Search stocks, ETFs, crypto, futures, and other markets using natural language to access real-time market conversations, retail sentiment, trending symbols, Watcher activity, and community insights. 

Whether you’re researching an earnings reaction, monitoring sentiment around a ticker, tracking breaking news, or discovering emerging market themes and trade ideas, Stocktwits provides context behind market moves, not just price updates.

Example prompts:
- What are traders saying about NVDA today?
- Latest news about NVDA today
- Why is PLTR trending?
- Compare sentiment for TSLA and RIVN.
- Which AI stocks are gaining the most retail attention?
- Summarize today’s discussion around Bitcoin.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stocktwits to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stocktwits to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.stocktwits.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stocktwits MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stocktwits lists 13 MCP tools, including get_following_feed, get_message_volume, get_message_volume_history, get_sentiment, get_sentiment_history, get_symbol, get_symbol_messages, get_symbol_pulse, get_trending_symbols, get_user_messages, get_watchlist_feed, and get_widget_registry.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stocktwits?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Stocktwits in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Stocktwits requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stocktwits is developed by Stocktwits. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
